create_interval_array_from_breaks: create an IntervalArray from an array of split points defining consecutive interval bounds
create_interval_array_from_arrays: create an IntervalArray from separate left and right bound arrays with a specified closure side
create_interval_array_from_tuples: create an IntervalArray from a sequence of (left, right) tuples
test_interval_array_overlaps: test whether an Interval overlaps each interval in an IntervalArray elementwise
test_interval_array_contains: test whether a scalar value is contained within each interval in an IntervalArray elementwise
build_interval_array_set_closed: build a new IntervalArray with the same bounds but a different closure side
build_interval_array_unique: build a new IntervalArray containing only unique intervals
build_interval_array_to_tuples: build an ndarray of (left, right) tuples from an IntervalArray
run_interval_array_shift: run a shift operation on an IntervalArray by a given number of periods with a fill value
run_interval_array_concat: run concatenation of multiple IntervalArrays with matching closure sides
refactor_interval_array_compare: refactor the interval comparison logic for equality, inequality, and ordering operations
review_interval_array_validation: review the IntervalArray validation that checks dtype, lengths, missing values, and bounds
summarize_interval_array_properties: summarize the left, right, mid, length, closed, and is_non_overlapping_monotonic properties
summarize_interval_array_isin: summarize the isin method for membership testing of intervals in another array of values
